description: Exploit and test the untested intermediate-resolution step. On E021, change the resolution schedule from 5x24 px + 5.75x32 px to 5x24 px + 2x28 px + 4x32 px (11 epochs in total), with the LR schedule (triangle plus Lookahead) defined over total steps. Use whole augmented images downscaled with bilinear F.interpolate, as for 24 px, and keep AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1) in the head. Batch 1536 with drop_last at all three shapes. Capture and warm up a third CUDA graph (28 px) in build so nothing recompiles in the timed region. Log per-phase ms/step.
